basic_details.job_title: DM&HO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 95 Contract / Outsourcing Posts under NHM / NUHM Posts
basic_details.job_location: Various health centres in Bhadradri Kothagudem district
basic_details.short_information: This is a district-level recruitment for NHM and NUHM posts in the health centres of Bhadradri Kothagudem district, issued as a press note (పత్రికా ప్రకటన) by the District Medical and Health Officer, who is also Member Secretary of the District Selection Committee (DSC). The press note does not specify the post names, qualification, age limit, pay or selection process; it states that the full post details, programme-wise vacancies and remuneration are in the annexures of the notification.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid by Demand Draft (D.D.) drawn on any nationalised bank in favour of "District Medical and Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem" and enclosed with the application. The notice does not mention any fee concession by category.

qualification.details: The press note invites applications from eligible candidates but does not print the qualification for any post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification in this press note; the post details are stated to be in its annexures. Candidates should check the official notification and its annexures for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the district official website https://kothagudem.telangana.gov.in/.
Fill in the application form completely.
Obtain a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,000/- from any nationalised bank in favour of "District Medical and Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem".
Attach the D.D. and the attested xerox copies to the filled application form.
Submit the application directly, or send it by registered post, to: Office of the District Medical and Health Officer, IDOC Complex, Palvancha, Bhadradri Kothagudem District.
Make sure it is delivered before 13.11.2026, 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: About DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Medical and Health Officer (DM&HO) is the district health office of Bhadradri Kothagudem district, located at the IDOC Complex, Palvancha. This recruitment covers vacancies in the district's health centres under the NHM and NUHM, and it is issued under the approved orders of the District Collector & District Magistrate and Chairman, District Selection Committee (DSC), Bhadradri Kothagudem.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 7 November 2026, the receipt of applications has not yet begun; it opens on 9 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 95 posts are to be filled under the NHM and NUHM in various health centres of Bhadradri Kothagudem district. The press note does not print the post-wise list; it states that the full details of the posts, the programme-wise vacancies and the remuneration are given in the annexures of the notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 95 posts under the NHM and NUHM in various health centres of Bhadradri Kothagudem district.

faq.question: Q2. When does the receipt of applications start?
faq.answer: Applications will be received from 9 November 2026, from 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 13 November 2026, till 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,000/-, paid by Demand Draft from any nationalised bank in favour of "District Medical and Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem" and enclosed with the application.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The application form is to be downloaded from the district official website, https://kothagudem.telangana.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Submit it at the Office of the District Medical and Health Officer, IDOC Complex, Palvancha, Bhadradri Kothagudem District, directly or by registered post, before 13 November 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, the 95 posts are to be filled on a contract / outsourcing basis under the NHM and NUHM.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: The fully filled application form, the Demand Draft of Rs. 1,000/- and attested xerox copies.
